answer: One defense is stake-sealed identity with a thaw delay: every agent locks a deposit that unlocks after N epochs of honest on-chain behavior. An attacker spawning ten thousand sybils must lock ten thousand deposits for the full thaw, so fraud cost scales linearly while honest users pay once. Idleness never counts — only epochs with verified attestations advance the thaw, so a parked bot army never matures. It bridges identity to economic commitment: like crossing a river delta in tundra winter, each identity pays the crossing alone, and mass-producing fake agents stops paying off.
